## Current status

| Evidence or workflow | Current status |
|---|---|
| Validation studies | **6 completed** — Studies 01–06 |
| Development studies | **1 in development** — Study 07 |
| Reusable templates | **6 available** — including annotation-informed analysis |

Study 06 is **closed at EST-R2**: annotation-induced prior rankings and SNP
inference are stable, while exact annotation-contrast magnitudes remain
uncertain. Its official qualifier is EST-R5, and same-posterior continuous-alpha
sampler development ended at PMA-R3. Read the
[final Study 06 conclusion](docs/studies/study06_final_conclusion.md).
Study 07 multitrait validation remains **In development**.

::: {.callout-note}
## How to read the evidence

A **completed** study passed its scientific and computational validation and
has a reviewed reference capsule. A **qualification failure** is an execution
boundary, not a method-performance result. Working output under
`results/local/` is not authoritative evidence.
:::

Learn how the pieces connect in the [Framework](framework.qmd), compare the
registered [Metrics](metrics.qmd), or review the capsule lifecycle under
[Reproducibility](reproducibility.qmd).
